policy.renderingSeed: same as selection seed for all methods; identical to existing hybrid/random controls
policy.pairwise: production twiseSeeder at t=2, max=budget; stop at complete pair coverage
policy.random: uniform sampling without replacement; rngFor(seed, budget) shuffled pool prefix
policy.rowScope: selected twise rows only; incomplete rows included in drawn coverage/balance, excluded from scoring
policy.timing: performance.now wall time from selection/drafting through rendering and fault scoring; excludes map load, disk output and analysis; rotated method order; no cached scoring
policy.faultScoring: reference-pass/fault-fail block witness; stop running a mutant after its first witness, as in prior controls
policy.interval: two-sided 95% Student t interval for the seed mean, df=29; assumes independent seed trials
policy.pairedTest: exact two-sided within-seed label swaps of the mean difference; integer-sum dynamic programming
policy.null: exchangeable method labels within each seed pair; independent swaps across pairs
policy.multiplicity: unadjusted tests; budgets and outcomes are dependent; no generalisation claim
